questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: What does GKE Sandbox provide?
options: Extra isolation for untrusted workloads using gVisor
questions.correct_rationale: GKE Sandbox adds a kernel isolation layer between pods and the host.
questions.distractor_summary: It is not a free cluster, registry, or firewall.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: Web application vulnerabilities such as XSS must be found in an App Engine or GKE app before release. Which Google tool can crawl and test the app?
options: Web Security Scanner in Security Command Center
questions.correct_rationale: Web Security Scanner tests public web apps for common vulnerabilities.
questions.distractor_summary: Scheduler, NAT, and VPN do not scan apps.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: What is the purpose of Policy Controller in GKE Enterprise?
options: Enforcing policies on Kubernetes resources, for example blocking privileged containers
questions.correct_rationale: Policy Controller uses OPA Gatekeeper constraints.
questions.distractor_summary: It does not host images, route traffic, or bill.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: Infrastructure must be deployed only through reviewed code, and drift must be detected. What approach fits?
options: Terraform in a CI/CD pipeline with reviews, restricted human write access, and periodic plan runs to detect drift
questions.correct_rationale: IaC pipelines provide review, traceability, and drift detection.
questions.distractor_summary: Console changes, shared accounts, and no version control lack control.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: Which Security Command Center feature identifies misconfigurations such as public buckets or open firewall ports?
questions.correct_rationale: Security Health Analytics scans for common misconfigurations.
questions.distractor_summary: Trace, Profiler, and Scheduler do not detect misconfigurations.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Which Cloud Audit Logs type is always enabled and cannot be disabled?
options: Policy Denied logs only for some services
questions.correct_rationale: Admin Activity logs record configuration changes and are always on.
questions.distractor_summary: Data Access logs are mostly off by default, and Flow Logs are not audit logs.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Read access to sensitive Cloud Storage objects must be logged. What should be enabled?
options: Data Access audit logs (DATA_READ) for Cloud Storage
questions.correct_rationale: Data Access logs capture reads of user data.
questions.distractor_summary: Admin Activity covers configuration changes, and CDN or NAT logs do not record object reads.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Logs from all projects must be kept for seven years in one place that project admins cannot delete. What design fits?
options: An organization-level aggregated log sink to a locked-retention log bucket or a Cloud Storage bucket with a locked retention policy in a security project
Keep logs in each project's default bucket
questions.correct_rationale: Aggregated sinks centralize logs, and locked retention prevents deletion.
questions.distractor_summary: Project buckets can be changed, laptops are unsafe, and disabling logging breaks compliance.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: What does Event Threat Detection in Security Command Center do?
options: Creates firewall rules automatically for all traffic
Analyzes logs to detect threats such as cryptomining, malware domains, and IAM anomalies
questions.correct_rationale: Event Threat Detection uses logs to find threats in near real time.
questions.distractor_summary: It does not encrypt, create rules for all traffic, or show billing.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Security findings must trigger automated responses, such as isolating a VM. What design fits?
options: Export SCC findings to Pub/Sub and trigger Cloud Functions or workflows that take action
questions.correct_rationale: Notification configs to Pub/Sub enable automated response.
questions.distractor_summary: Weekly email and printing are slow, and ignoring findings adds risk.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: What are VPC Flow Logs used for in security operations?
options: Recording network flow metadata to investigate suspicious connections
questions.correct_rationale: Flow logs help investigations and anomaly detection.
questions.distractor_summary: They do not encrypt, block, or assign IPs.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: A company wants to analyze security logs with detection rules at scale and run investigations. Which Google security product fits?
questions.correct_rationale: Security Operations ingests logs and runs detections and response playbooks.
questions.distractor_summary: CDN, Memorystore, and Scheduler are not security tools.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: What does Access Transparency provide?
options: Logs of actions taken by Google staff when they access customer content
questions.correct_rationale: Access Transparency shows Google personnel access to your data.
questions.distractor_summary: It does not log user sign-ins, firewalls, or billing.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Alerts are needed when someone changes an IAM policy on a production project. What should be configured?
options: A log-based alert in Cloud Monitoring on SetIamPolicy events in Admin Activity logs
questions.correct_rationale: Log-based alerts can match specific audit log entries.
questions.distractor_summary: Uptime checks, CDN, and NAT do not watch IAM changes.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: What does Container Threat Detection in SCC detect?
options: Suspicious runtime behavior in GKE containers, such as reverse shells or added binaries
questions.correct_rationale: Container Threat Detection monitors container runtime events.
questions.distractor_summary: Misconfigurations, billing, and DNS are other areas.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Logs must be restricted so that only the security team can see Data Access logs, while developers see application logs. What should be configured?
options: One shared bucket with everyone as viewer
Separate log buckets or log views with IAM on each view
questions.correct_rationale: Log views and buckets give fine-grained log access.
questions.distractor_summary: Shared viewers expose sensitive logs, public links leak data, and disabling app logs hurts developers.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Which tool queries the current and historical state of resources and IAM policies across the organization?
questions.correct_rationale: Asset Inventory provides searchable resource and policy history.
questions.distractor_summary: Trace, Build, and CDN do not inventory resources.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Security Command Center must cover all projects in the organization. At what level should it be activated?
options: Only in a folder with no projects
questions.correct_rationale: Organization-level activation gives visibility across all projects.
questions.distractor_summary: Single projects, empty folders, and VMs are too narrow.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: What is the purpose of mute rules in Security Command Center?
options: Hiding findings that are expected or accepted, so teams can focus on real issues
questions.correct_rationale: Mute rules reduce noise from known findings.
questions.distractor_summary: They do not delete, encrypt, or create rules.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: An incident requires preserving evidence from a compromised VM. What should be done first?
options: Snapshot the disks, keep logs, isolate the VM with firewall rules or tags, and avoid deleting it
questions.correct_rationale: Preserving evidence supports investigation while containing the threat.
questions.distractor_summary: Deletion, reboots, and disabled logs destroy evidence.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Which SCC tier adds attack path simulation and more advanced threat detection?
questions.correct_rationale: Higher SCC tiers include attack path simulation and more detectors.
questions.distractor_summary: Standard has fewer features, and the other tiers do not exist.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: A company needs to run regulated workloads with data residency and personnel controls, such as FedRAMP or EU sovereignty requirements. What should be used?
options: A public project with no controls
Assured Workloads with the appropriate control package
questions.correct_rationale: Assured Workloads applies compliance controls to folders.
questions.distractor_summary: Public projects, CDN, and personal accounts do not provide compliance controls.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Where can customers download Google Cloud compliance reports such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certificates?
questions.correct_rationale: Compliance Reports Manager provides audit reports.
questions.distractor_summary: Shell, Scheduler, and Artifact Registry do not host reports.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Under the shared responsibility model, who is responsible for configuring IAM and firewall rules for a customer's Compute Engine VMs?
questions.correct_rationale: Customers configure access controls on IaaS resources.
questions.distractor_summary: Google secures the infrastructure, and ISPs and auditors do not configure customer controls.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: What does Access Approval provide?
options: Requiring explicit customer approval before Google personnel access customer content in supported services
questions.correct_rationale: Access Approval adds a customer approval step for Google access.
questions.distractor_summary: It is not for PRs, firewalls, or invoices.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Data must stay in a specific region to meet residency rules. What should be combined?
options: Resource location organization policies, regional resources, and Assured Workloads where needed
questions.correct_rationale: Location policies and regional services keep data in approved places.
questions.distractor_summary: Global resources may spread data, trust alone is weak, and public buckets add exposure.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Which Security Command Center feature maps findings to compliance frameworks like CIS and PCI DSS?
options: The compliance dashboard in Security Command Center
questions.correct_rationale: SCC shows compliance posture against standards.
questions.distractor_summary: CDN, Profiler, and Tasks do not map compliance.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: A company must show auditors that only approved configurations are used, with continuous checks and evidence. What should it use?
options: Security Command Center posture management with predefined postures and organization policies, plus logs as evidence
questions.correct_rationale: Posture management continuously checks configuration against policies.
questions.distractor_summary: Screenshots, yearly spreadsheets, and statements are not continuous evidence.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: What is the purpose of a PCI DSS scope reduction strategy in Google Cloud?
options: Isolating cardholder data systems in separate projects and networks so fewer systems are in scope
Putting all systems in one project
questions.correct_rationale: Segmentation limits which systems handle card data.
questions.distractor_summary: One project expands scope, logging card numbers is forbidden, and public buckets are unsafe.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Healthcare data must be handled under HIPAA on Google Cloud. What is a key first step?
options: Use any service without an agreement
Sign a Business Associate Agreement with Google and use only covered services, configured securely
questions.correct_rationale: A BAA and covered services are required for HIPAA workloads.
questions.distractor_summary: Uncovered services, personal drives, and no logs break compliance.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: What do Sovereign Controls by Partners or Google Cloud's sovereign offerings typically add?
options: Controls such as data location, key management outside Google, and restricted personnel access for regulated customers
questions.correct_rationale: Sovereign offerings focus on control over data, keys, and access.
questions.distractor_summary: They do not add speed, free storage, or public IPs.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Auditors need proof of who changed a firewall rule six months ago. What should be available?
options: Admin Activity audit logs retained in a central log bucket for the required period
questions.correct_rationale: Audit logs record who changed what and when.
questions.distractor_summary: Current rules lack history, and serial output and billing do not record changes.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Which organization policy helps meet a requirement that VMs must not have external IP addresses?
questions.correct_rationale: This constraint restricts which VMs can have external IPs.
questions.distractor_summary: The others limit IAM domains, bucket access mode, and locations.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Only users from the company's own domain should be granted IAM roles. What constraint enforces this?
questions.correct_rationale: Domain restricted sharing limits IAM members to allowed customer IDs.
questions.distractor_summary: The other constraints control networks, OS Login, and SQL IPs.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Why do regulated companies enable Data Access audit logs for sensitive services?
options: To have evidence of who read or changed data, as required by many standards
questions.correct_rationale: Data access evidence supports compliance audits.
questions.distractor_summary: It adds cost, does not speed queries, and has no effect on encryption.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: A new compliance rule requires that all GKE clusters use Shielded GKE nodes. What is the most scalable control?
options: An organization policy or Policy Controller constraint enforcing the setting, plus SCC checks for existing clusters
questions.correct_rationale: Preventive policies and detective checks scale enforcement.
questions.distractor_summary: Reminders and one-time checks are weak, and deleting clusters is drastic.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: A company must show that encryption keys are rotated regularly. Where can evidence come from?
options: Cloud KMS key metadata with rotation periods and key version creation times, plus audit logs
questions.correct_rationale: KMS metadata and logs show rotation history.
questions.distractor_summary: CPU, CDN, and latency charts do not show key rotation.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Which service lets customers define and apply security and compliance policies as code across Google Cloud resources, including checks in CI pipelines?
options: Policy as code with tools such as gcloud beta terraform vet or Policy Controller constraints
questions.correct_rationale: Policy as code validates configurations before and after deployment.
questions.distractor_summary: CDN, Scheduler, and Memorystore do not validate policy.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Data subject deletion requests under GDPR must be honored across BigQuery and Cloud Storage. What helps?
options: Data inventory with Sensitive Data Protection and Dataplex, plus documented deletion processes that cover backups and copies
questions.correct_rationale: Knowing where personal data lives enables complete deletion.
questions.distractor_summary: Ignoring requests breaks law, deleting projects is excessive, and public data violates privacy.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: Containers must run without root privileges and with read-only file systems on GKE. How can this be enforced across clusters?
options: Pod Security Admission or Policy Controller constraints that reject non-compliant pods
questions.correct_rationale: Admission controls enforce pod security settings automatically.
questions.distractor_summary: Wikis are not enforced, privileged pods are insecure, and public IPs are unrelated.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: What does the Container-Optimized OS provide for GKE nodes?
options: A minimal, hardened operating system with a read-only root file system and automatic updates
questions.correct_rationale: COS reduces attack surface for container hosts.
questions.distractor_summary: It is not a desktop, database, or load balancer.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: Secrets used by a Cloud Run service must not appear in environment variables in plain text in the service config. What should be done?
options: Paste the secret into the container image
Put the secret in a public bucket
Reference Secret Manager secrets from the Cloud Run service as mounted volumes or environment variables resolved at runtime
Commit the secret to the repository
questions.correct_rationale: Cloud Run integrates with Secret Manager so secrets stay managed and audited.
questions.distractor_summary: Images, public buckets, and repos expose secrets.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: Which Artifact Registry feature reduces the risk of pulling compromised public packages?
options: Remote repositories that cache approved upstream packages, combined with scanning
questions.correct_rationale: Remote repositories proxy and cache packages under your control.
questions.distractor_summary: Anonymous push, disabled scanning, and VM storage increase risk.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: Engineers need to fix a misconfiguration found by Security Health Analytics on many projects. What is a scalable approach?
options: Fix each resource manually and do nothing else
Fix the template or Terraform module and redeploy, and add an org policy to prevent recurrence
questions.correct_rationale: Fixing the source and adding guardrails stops repeats.
questions.distractor_summary: Manual fixes recur, muting hides issues, and deleting projects is drastic.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.subdomain: 4.1 Building and deploying secure infrastructure and applications
questions.question: What does VM Manager OS inventory provide?
options: A list of installed packages and OS details on VMs to support vulnerability management
questions.correct_rationale: OS inventory helps find vulnerable software.
questions.distractor_summary: It does not provide firewall, DNS, or billing data.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: A security team needs to analyze audit logs with SQL across many projects. What should be configured?
options: Read logs one project at a time in the console
Route logs through an aggregated sink to a log bucket with Log Analytics enabled, or to BigQuery
questions.correct_rationale: Log Analytics and BigQuery allow SQL queries over central logs.
questions.distractor_summary: Per-project reading is slow, spreadsheets do not scale, and disabling logs loses data.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: What is a log exclusion filter used for?
options: Preventing selected log entries from being stored, to reduce noise and cost
questions.correct_rationale: Exclusions drop matching logs before storage.
questions.distractor_summary: They do not encrypt, create rules, or grant roles.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: High-volume debug logs are expensive, but audit logs must never be excluded. How should exclusions be designed?
options: Write exclusion filters that target only the debug log names or severities, and leave the _Required bucket and audit logs untouched
questions.correct_rationale: Narrow exclusions cut cost without losing required logs.
questions.distractor_summary: Broad exclusions lose data, and the _Required bucket and Admin Activity logs cannot be removed.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: Which Google Cloud log bucket stores Admin Activity and System Event audit logs for 400 days and cannot be changed?
questions.correct_rationale: The _Required bucket has fixed retention for required logs.
questions.distractor_summary: _Default and custom buckets are configurable, and Cloud Storage is a sink target.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: The SOC wants alerts when a service account key is created anywhere in the organization. What should be configured?
options: An organization-level log sink or log-based alert on CreateServiceAccountKey audit events
questions.correct_rationale: Audit logs capture key creation, and alerts can match those events.
questions.distractor_summary: Budget, CPU, and CDN alerts do not watch key creation.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.domain: 4. Managing operations within a cloud solution environment
questions.question: What does Virtual Machine Threat Detection in SCC detect?
options: Threats such as cryptomining and kernel rootkits by scanning VM memory from the hypervisor
questions.correct_rationale: VM Threat Detection inspects guest memory without agents.
questions.distractor_summary: Passwords, buckets, and billing are other areas.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: A company must keep audit evidence of who accessed customer data at Google. What should be enabled?
options: Access Transparency, and Access Approval for supported services if approval is required
questions.correct_rationale: These features log and control Google personnel access.
questions.distractor_summary: NAT logs, serial console, and CDN do not record Google access.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Under the shared responsibility model, who secures the physical data centers for Google Cloud?
questions.correct_rationale: Google is responsible for physical security of its infrastructure.
questions.distractor_summary: Customers, auditors, and ISPs do not secure Google's facilities.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Compliance requires that no data be processed outside the EU, including support access. Which option fits best?
options: Assured Workloads with an EU data boundary control package, plus resource location policies
Cloud CDN with global caching for all data
questions.correct_rationale: Assured Workloads enforces data residency and personnel access controls.
questions.distractor_summary: Global resources and CDN caching may process data elsewhere, and public datasets are uncontrolled.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: What is a key reason to label or tag resources with data classification?
options: To apply the right controls and show auditors which resources hold regulated data
questions.correct_rationale: Classification metadata guides controls and audits.
questions.distractor_summary: Tags do not change performance, latency, or encryption.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: An auditor asks how the company limits who can create public IPs. What is the best evidence?
options: The organization policy constraint settings and audit logs showing enforcement
A verbal statement from the team
A single screenshot from last year
questions.correct_rationale: Policy configuration and logs provide verifiable evidence.
questions.distractor_summary: Statements and old screenshots are weak, and billing does not show controls.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Which Google Cloud service helps meet requirements for separation of duties between key administrators and data users?
options: Cloud KMS with separate projects and IAM roles for key admins and key users
questions.correct_rationale: Keeping keys in a separate project with distinct roles separates duties.
questions.distractor_summary: CDN, Functions, and Tasks do not manage keys.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: A financial regulator requires that backups be immutable for a set period. What can be used in Google Cloud?
options: Backup and DR Service backup vaults with enforced retention, or Cloud Storage buckets with locked retention policies
questions.correct_rationale: Enforced retention prevents deletion or change during the required period.
questions.distractor_summary: The other options can be altered or lost.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: What does the term "data residency" mean?
options: The requirement that data is stored in specific geographic locations
The number of copies of data
questions.correct_rationale: Data residency concerns where data is stored.
questions.distractor_summary: It is not about speed, copy count, or database type.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: A company wants continuous monitoring of CIS benchmark compliance for Google Cloud. What should it use?
options: Security Command Center compliance reporting for CIS Google Cloud Foundations Benchmark
questions.correct_rationale: SCC maps findings to CIS controls.
questions.distractor_summary: Scheduler, CDN, and build triggers do not track compliance.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Why should regulated workloads use separate projects from non-regulated workloads?
options: To limit the compliance scope and apply stricter controls only where needed
Because projects cannot hold more than one VM
questions.correct_rationale: Separation reduces scope and simplifies audits.
questions.distractor_summary: There is benefit, projects can hold many VMs, and logging should stay on.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: A company's policy requires that deleted data be unrecoverable. How does Google Cloud support this?
options: Customers must physically destroy Google's disks
Deleting a VM leaves data readable forever
Google follows a documented data deletion process, and crypto-shredding by destroying CMEK keys can make data unreadable
questions.correct_rationale: Deletion processes and key destruction support data disposal requirements.
questions.distractor_summary: Data can be deleted, customers cannot access hardware, and VM data is not readable forever.

questions.exam: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer
questions.subdomain: 5.1 Adhering to regulatory and industry standards requirements for the cloud
questions.question: Which document describes Google Cloud's commitments for processing customer data under privacy laws?
questions.correct_rationale: The data processing terms describe privacy commitments.
questions.distractor_summary: Pricing pages, quickstarts, and CLI references do not cover this.
